targets.title: Method boundary 1
targets.detail: Score = (positive token count − negative token count) / all English word tokens, using the exact supplied word list.

targets.title: Method boundary 2
targets.detail: This simple method does not understand negation, context or entity-specific sentiment. A missing match is unavailable, not neutral.

targets.title: Method boundary 3
targets.detail: Headline aliases establish relevance; provider tags alone do not. Identical text can cluster; independent stories are not established.

targets.title: Method boundary 4
targets.detail: No FinBERT, Loughran–McDonald dictionary, model download or return forecast is implied. All tone is diagnostic and requires review.
